next_required_actions.why: a verified binding needs a verifier, and nobody can be one until a person can authenticate. Gate 111 built the contracts that decide who may verify - the auth principal, the binder authorization and the RLS claim guard - but the login promotion gate still reports seven of ten gates missing, so no provider is attached
the OIDC identity mapper resolves a claim to organization_profile_id, a String(128) with no foreign key on a table with no RLS. Even a live login would not produce the UUID the policies enforce on
org_id is a uuid.UUID in routes and a free-form string in most of the ~70 services using it; a migration assuming the first is wrong wherever the second holds
organization_id primary anchor, tenant label column, the Gate 109 statuses, a verifier and a verified_at
there is no verified binding to migrate; the table starts empty and fills as bindings are verified
